name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let i' : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let j : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i' - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, i', Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.sub_sub, ← Nat.sub_sub,
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' $ h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)),
      pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i'
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let Δ := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let sizes := (fun g : C => (Δ g.val).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (show sizes.Nonempty from
    Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := Δ g.val
  change Y.ncard = d at hg
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    i' steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr (x) :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x $ q x).mp rfl
  have hb : hammingDist f g.val ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hc := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn
      (s := {x | f x ≠ g.val x})
      (t := Y ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin $ 2 ^ steps)))
      (fun x => (q x, k x))
      (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
      (by
        intro x hx z hz h
        obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
        dsimp only [k] at hk
        exact (hr x).symm.trans $ by rw [hq, hk]; exact hr z)
    simp only [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin, hg] at hc
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Set.toFinset_setOf] at hc
    exact hc
  have hfw : 2 * d ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 j - 1 :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ht : 2 * hammingDist f g.val < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 i' := by
    have hh := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans
      (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw)
    rw [hid] at hh
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hh
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ $ WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 ht
  exact mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y
      𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (fiberMap k))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, if_false, if_true, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq hd
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  rw [hd]
  dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset

theorem substOldPostSubset:

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have := InitStatesLength hi
  refine exists_eq_left.mpr ⟨updatedStatesInit this (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu
  have := UpdateStatesLength hu
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate this $ updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu)
  · simp [List.unzip_zip, *]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  constructor
  existsi ChoiceBisim.choice h
  constructor
  · constructor
    intro s t hr
    cases hr <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · rintro s t (h | h) μ s' ht
    · cases ht <;> rename_i ht
      · exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
      · exact ⟨_, .choiceR ht, .bisim $ HomBisimilarity.refl _⟩
    · exact (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ => And.imp_right ChoiceBisim.bisim

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hc hd, .par hc' hd'⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ‹_›⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨c, .red_K .., hc⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨d, e, hd, he, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., by apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hAn (n : ℕ) := hA.of_le (m := n) ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable $ by decide
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c)
    (i := j) (hAn _) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    (hAn _) (j, i)
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid $ electricField_differentiable_time (hAn _) _,
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq]
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    simp only [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv $ hB j, time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A $ hAn _,
      Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ $ hEs j]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2]
    simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    rw [← _root_.sum_apply, ← fderiv_fun_sum $ fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt]
    change ∂[i] ((∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) ·) x
    simp only [((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t _).1,
      div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_mul_const
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        hJd t).differentiableAt]
    change _ * ∂[i] _ x
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, mul_assoc, FreeSpace.c_sq, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices h : (mulLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂ₛₗ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) from
    LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h a b
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, c, ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul ι, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
    timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul]
  obtain ⟨x, y, ht⟩ : ∃ x y : 𝓕.WickAlgebra, ∀ l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp,
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
        x * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * y :=
    ⟨_, _, fun l h => by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ _ _ _ h]
      simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul ι]
      exact mul_assoc _ _ _⟩
  have h0 := ht [] $ by simp
  have h12 := ht [φ, ψ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ]
  have h21 := ht [ψ, φ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ]
  simp at h0 h12 h21
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (x * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y)
  · simp only [↓superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul, map_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
      ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, h12, h21, smul_sub]
    rw [smul_comm]
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $ ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ,
    mul_assoc, ← h0]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · congr 1
    exact Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm _ _
  · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  refine le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt ?_) real_inner_self_nonneg'
  intro hpos
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hcompact, hsmooth, hrange, hφx⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
      (hc.continuousAt.eventually (le_mem_nhds hpos))
  apply ((hsmooth.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
    hcompact.mul_right (fun y => Classical.byCases
      (fun hy => mul_nonneg (hrange ⟨y, rfl⟩).1 (hs hy))
      (fun hy => by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]))
    (mul_ne_zero (hφx.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hpos.ne')).ne'
  simp only [← inner_smul_right']
  apply hg
  exact IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hsmooth, hcompact⟩ contDiff_const

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε)  := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  ·
    intro u hp
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    rewrite [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (u := u),
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, ENNReal.coe_natCast, one_mul] using hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u)
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) u e ?_) ?_
    · rewrite [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simpa only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u), Fin.init_def,
        ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v n : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f n := (v n, v $ n+1, v $ n+2, v $ n+3)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Finite.wellQuasiOrdered Eq f
  have eqs : ∀ m, f (i+m) = f (j+m) := Nat.rec he fun m ih => by
      simp +zetaDelta at ih ⊢
      rify
      simp +arith only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.reduceSub, ih, and_self]
  refine ⟨i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  simpa only [← Nat.add_sub_assoc, hn, hij.le, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using congrArg (·.1.val) (eqs $ n-i).symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not] at *
  rw [← Nat.mul_left_cancel_iff Nat.two_pos, mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero,
    ← Fintype.card_set, ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have update (a b : _ → ℤ) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  simp only [hrelation, update] at h
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) fun i _ => h.1.2 i
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const,

    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  intro i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from by decide).pow_right (n := i.1) |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine (dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)))
    (dvd_add (h.1.2 i) (h.2.2 i))).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  ring1
